output.name: Broken CAD references after part renames
output.summary: Engineers open assemblies, parts or drawings and find missing references or empty components, often after a colleague renamed parts, and must wait for support to re-resolve references from the vault.

root_cause.text: Likely, renaming parts does not update the references held by parent assemblies and drawings, so dependent files lose their links until someone manually resolves them from the vault.

quotes.quote: Missing references after a colleague renamed parts.
Resolved references from vault and checked in.

evidence.text: Many tickets explicitly tie the missing references to a colleague renaming parts.

evidence.text: The symptom affects assemblies, parts and drawings alike, showing up either as missing references or as empty components.
Every ticket is closed with the same manual workaround, so the underlying cause is never addressed.

quotes.quote: Resolved references from vault and checked in.

output.fix: Make part renames go only through a vault-controlled rename that automatically updates and checks in all where-used assemblies and drawings, and block renames done outside the vault.
